operations.title: Entry 1273 — The Five-Site Adjoint Numerator Collapses to a Scalar on the Physical Kummer Cover
operations.body: Reducing Entry 1270's exact 13,304-term numerator modulo the five Entry 1217 Kummer equations on Entry 1257's determinant-one routing gives C_empty=99,408,314,880,000 and C_S=0 for all 31 nontrivial deck characters. Four direct evaluations over F_1009 and F_1013 independently verify the identity. The physical integrand has constant numerator over all 26 labelled walls; this does not imply rank-one period cohomology.

operations.title: Benincasa finds exact adjoint collapse on the physical five-site cover
operations.body: Entry 1273 is a strong simplification. The exact 13,304-term degree-16 numerator from Entry 1270 reduces modulo Entry 1217's five Kummer relations to the scalar 99,408,314,880,000; all 31 nontrivial deck-character coefficients vanish. Four independent finite-field cover evaluations confirm it. Thus the physical integrand is constant divided by the 26 labelled wall factors. This is presentation complexity collapsing on the Carrier-constrained physical object—not a rank-one period claim. Next target: twisted de Rham rank of the marked complement.
